Article Title: 'I hope they don’t go to prayer later': Furious Ruben Neves hits back after Al-Taawoun fans taunt him with Diogo Jota’s name
Article Text:
Ruben Neves furious after Al-Taawoun fans taunt him with late friend Diogo Jota’s name during match/ Image:X

Neves reacts after Al-Taawoun fans chant Jota 's name

“God sees you.”

“I hope they don't go to prayer later after what they did,”

Neves shared a deep bond with Liverpool icon Diogo Jota

Ruben Neves had little to complain about on the pitch as Al-Hilal stormed to a 6-0 victory, but the Portugal international was visibly angered by what happened in the stands.Neves was targeted by Al-Taawoun supporters during Saturday's meeting in Buraidah, with fans chanting the name of his late friend and former Portugal team-mate Diogo Jota . The incident left the Al-Hilal midfielder furious, and he had a pointed response when he was approached after the final whistle.Al-Hilal produced a dominant display in the seventh round of the Saudi Roshn League, sweeping aside Al-Taawoun 6-0 at the hosts' stadium.Yet the result was overshadowed for Neves by an incident involving a group of Al-Taawoun supporters.A video shared on X by Aziz Al-Dahmashi appeared to show an altercation between Neves and fans during the match. The trouble flared after supporters began chanting Jota's name, which appeared to provoke an angry response from the Portuguese midfielder.Neves was seen pointing towards the sky and telling the supporters:When he later walked past the media after the match, he did not go into detail about the incident or single out any individual. Instead, he offered a brief response that made his feelings clear.Neves said.His remark appeared to be a direct condemnation of the use of Jota's name during the match, contrasting the behaviour he had witnessed with religious and human values.Neves chose not to elaborate further, allowing those few words to speak for themselves.The significance of the incident lies in the relationship Neves had with Jota, who died alongside his younger brother André Silva, a professional footballer who played for Penafiel in Portugal’s second division, in a tragic car accident in the Spanish region of Cernadilla in July last year.Their friendship began at Porto, where both players came through the club's system before continuing their careers together at Wolverhampton Wanderers. They later shared the Portugal dressing room, remaining close as their careers developed at the highest level.Jota went on to become a hugely important figure for Liverpool after joining the club in 2020. His movement, pressing and instinctive finishing made him a key part of Jurgen Klopp's attack, while his ability to score from difficult positions quickly made him a favourite at Anfield.He scored decisive goals in the Premier League and Champions League, helped Liverpool compete for major honours and became known for his intelligence inside the penalty area. Jota was not simply a squad player during his time on Merseyside; he was a forward trusted in the biggest matches and a player whose goals regularly changed the course of games.His importance to Liverpool was reflected in the affection shown by supporters, team-mates and staff following his death. Tributes poured in from across the football world, with the club and its fans mourning a player remembered not only for his performances but also for his character away from the pitch.Neves has spoken publicly on more than one occasion about the profound grief he experienced following Jota's death. Their connection had been built over many years, through club football, international duty and a friendship that continued long after they stopped playing for the same team.That history made the chanting particularly painful for Neves, who appeared to view the use of Jota's name as a deeply personal provocation rather than ordinary football banter.
Article Summary: Ruben neves furious after al-taawoun fans taunt him with late friend diogo jota’s name during match. The incident left the al-hilal midfielder furious, and he had a pointed response when he was approached after the final whistle. Neves shared a deep bond with liverpool icon jota.

Article Title: Jasprit Bumrah, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi on Afghanistan's radar: Ibrahim Zadran reveals plans
Article Text:
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Jasprit Bumrah (Image credit: Agencies)

Sooryavanshi also on Afghanistan's radar

Zadran takes over T20I captaincy

Afghanistan eye first series win over India

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Afghanistan captain Ibrahim Zadran says his team has made specific plans to deal with Jasprit Bumrah in Sunday's opening T20I against India at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in New Delhi.Bumrah is set to return to international cricket after missing matches due to a left knee injury. His return gives India another major option with the ball, but Zadran said Afghanistan will not make things complicated while facing the star pacer."If you look at Jasprit Bumrah, he is one of the best, and he is my favourite fast bowler. We as a group never think things in a complicated way for ourselves. So we have a very good plan for him, and we just thought about him, how to play against him, and hopefully we are going to play better cricket against Jasprit Bumrah or the Indian Cricket Team," Zadran told reporters in a press conference on Saturday.Afghanistan have also prepared for India's teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.The Afghanistan team has used information from players who have faced the left-handed opener in the IPL. Zadran said they have also studied videos of Sooryavanshi before the series."He is an amazing talent. Recently, he played great cricket in the Indian Premier League (IPL), and he has been performing well at a different level in cricket events.We have thought about him, and we have gained that knowledge from those guys who have played against him in the IPL.“We have already watched his videos, and we just try to keep it very simple for ourselves, just to execute the right plans at the right time against him. We are just trying to make things simple for us, not complicated," he stated.Zadran has taken over the T20I captaincy from Rashid Khan. He believes their strong relationship will help Afghanistan make a fresh start after their early exit from the T20 World Cup.The new captain also feels Afghanistan's experience of playing in India will be useful."I would say, I was destined to have a captain like Rashid Khan. Alongside him, we had better communication, better understanding between us. When he was a captain, I was helping him as a vice-captain, and the understanding is there.“Yes, we have played enough cricket here in India; we all know the conditions, how to play, how to adjust ourselves, and we have played a series here against India, and the T20 World Cup, and the 50-over World Cup as well. We know the conditions really well, and how to play. We just need to execute the plan really well, according to the opposition, and that's it."Afghanistan are yet to beat India in a bilateral T20I series and Zadran is hoping his side can change that this time.He said the key will be to execute their plans properly and focus on the process instead of worrying about the result."Yes, we have played better cricket against India. In 2024, we had two super overs against them in the T20I series in Bengaluru.“At the ICC events, we have played better cricket against them. As you mentioned, we have never beaten them. Hopefully, we are going to play a good series, win a game, and win a series from them. But it's all about execution of the plan and giving your 100 percent.“It’s about trying to make things easy for ourselves, not complicated. Yes, we just try to give 100 percent. Don't think about the result; just try to think about the process, and how we are going to deliver. I am sure we will have a better series."
Article Summary: Afghanistan captain ibrahim zadran says his team has made specific plans to deal with jasprit bumrah in sunday's opening t20i against india. The afghanistan team has also prepared for india's teenage batting sensation vaibhav sooryavanshi. Zadran has taken over the t20i captaincy from rashid khan.

Article Title: Cristiano Ronaldo listed his 23-acre Cheshire estate with a 7-bedroom mansion for $7.4 million; after more than 18 months on the market, it fell to $6.7 million
Article Text:
Cristiano Ronaldo listed his 23-acre Cheshire estate with a 7-bedroom mansion for $7.4 million; after more than 18 months on the market, it fell to $6.7 million

What does Cristiano Ronaldo’s 23-acre Cheshire estate include

Why did Cristiano Ronaldo leave the Cheshire mansion after returning to Manchester United

Why was Cristiano Ronaldo’s Cheshire estate listed for sale in 2023

Why did Cristiano Ronaldo’s property price fall to $6.7 million

$6.7 million

How did Cristiano Ronaldo’s earlier Cheshire home perform when he sold it

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Cristiano Ronaldo’s former Cheshire estate was listed for about $7.4 million in 2023, but the asking price was later reduced to around $6.7 million after the property struggled to find a buyer. The huge estate in Alderley Edge covers 23 acres and includes a seven-bedroom mansion, six bathrooms, an indoor heated pool, gym, sauna, jacuzzi and cinema. There are also tennis and padel courts and a separate two-bedroom guest barn. Ronaldo moved into the property after returning to Manchester United in 2021, but his family soon moved to another Cheshire home. The estate was later put up for sale after his move to Saudi Arabia.Ronaldo’s former Cheshire home is built on a scale that goes well beyond a typical luxury house. The estate covers 23 acres in Alderley Edge, one of the well-known wealthy areas in Cheshire, while the main mansion has seven bedrooms and six bathrooms.The house was designed with both family life and fitness in mind. The main bedroom has private dressing areas and walk-in wardrobe space, while the other bedrooms have en-suite facilities.A large leisure area is one of the biggest features of the property. It has an indoor heated swimming pool, sauna and jacuzzi, along with a professional gym. For entertainment, there is a private cinema room and a wine cellar.The outdoor space adds even more to the property. Ronaldo’s former estate has a full-sized tennis court and a padel court, giving the owner options for sport without leaving the grounds.There is also a separate two-bedroom guest barn. It provides additional space for visitors, staff or security personnel while keeping the main house private.When Jackson-Stops listed the property, the estate agency described it as a “masterpiece of modern design set in 23 acres - an ultra stylish main residence with superb leisure suite, two bedroom guest barn and padel court.”Ronaldo did not stay in the mansion for long after returning to Manchester United in 2021. He and his family moved out soon after arriving in the area and shifted to another property in Cheshire.One explanation that appeared in reports at the time involved the land around the house. The estate bordered open farmland, and early-morning noise from sheep was said to have been a problem for Ronaldo.However, that detail has been disputed and should not be treated as the confirmed reason for the move. Privacy and security were also reported as concerns, especially because a public footpath ran close to the property.For someone as well known as Ronaldo, having people regularly passing near the estate could make privacy harder to maintain. His family therefore moved to another Cheshire property that had previously been owned by former Manchester United striker Andrew Cole.That home offered stronger security measures, including electric gates and CCTV, making it a better fit for the family.Ronaldo’s second Manchester United spell ended in November 2022 after his contract was terminated by mutual consent. The decision followed his high-profile television interview with Piers Morgan, in which he openly criticized the club and its leadership.A few weeks later, Ronaldo began the next stage of his career in Saudi Arabia after signing for Al-Nassr. That move also changed where he and his family spent most of their time.With Ronaldo no longer playing in Manchester, keeping a 23-acre estate in Cheshire made less sense. The property had already not been his family’s main home during the latter part of his United spell.Jackson-Stops placed the estate on the market in February 2023 with an asking price of £5.5 million, which was about $7.4 million based on the conversion used for the listing.The sale came as Ronaldo’s property holdings continued to stretch across several countries. Rather than keeping a large home in northern England that he was no longer using, the Cheshire estate became a property he could sell.Finding a buyer for a property of this size can take time. Ronaldo’s Cheshire estate remained on the market for more than 18 months, and the asking price was eventually reduced by £500,000.The new guide price was £5 million, or aboutThe reduction does not mean the property was sold for $6.7 million. It was the lower asking price after the original listing failed to attract a buyer within the expected period.There are practical reasons why a property like this can take longer to sell. The estate has 23 acres of land, which means a buyer is taking on much more than the upkeep of a normal house. The mansion also has a long list of specialist facilities, including an indoor pool, gym, tennis court and padel court.Those features can be attractive to the right buyer, but they can also make the property more expensive and demanding to maintain.The price cut also stands out because Ronaldo has previously experienced a difficult sale in the same area.Ronaldo owned another house in Alderley Edge during his first Manchester United spell. That property was a five-bedroom brick house with luxury facilities, including an indoor swimming pool and gym.He bought the earlier property in 2008 for a reported £3.895 million. It was eventually sold in 2019 for £3.25 million, meaning the sale price was around £645,000 lower than what he had originally paid.That house and the current 23-acre estate are different properties, but both show that even a famous footballer’s luxury home can take time to sell.The current estate was bought around Cristiano Ronaldo’s return to Manchester United and later became unnecessary after his career moved away from England. Its large size and unusual collection of facilities also put it into a small section of the property market.For now, the important change is the asking price. Cristiano Ronaldo’s former seven-bedroom Cheshire estate went from about $7.4 million to $6.7 million, but a final sale price has not been confirmed.
Article Summary: Cristiano ronaldo listed his 23-acre cheshire estate with a 7-bedroom mansion for $7.4 million in 2023. After more than 18 months on the market, it fell to $6.7 million. Ronaldo moved into the property after returning to manchester united in 2021, but his family soon moved to another cheshire home.

Article Title: Devastated Aryna Sabalenka smashes racket, hits ball into crowd after US Open defeat to Elena Rybakina
Article Text:
Aryna Sabalenka reacts during the women's singles final of the US Open against Elena Rybakina (left) and Sabalenka smashes her racket after losing the women's singles final, Saturday, Sept. 12, 2026, in New York.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Elena Rybakina came to New York and took everything that had belonged to Aryna Sabalenka. First, it was the No. 1 ranking in women's tennis, then the US Open trophy.The tournament that for so long was a struggle for Rybakina turned into the site of her coronation.Elena Rybakina won her first US Open title on Saturday after beating Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final, completing a run that also took her to the No. 1 spot in the WTA rankings.Rybakina had already secured the top ranking from next week and also ended Sabalenka’s two-year reign as US Open champion.“It’s still so difficult to process what happened,” Rybakina said. “Too many achievements these few weeks.”The US Open title is Rybakina’s third Grand Slam title and her second of the year. Both of her Grand Slam wins this season came against Sabalenka on hard courts, after she also defeated the Belarusian in the Australian Open final.Rybakina also ended Sabalenka’s 19-match winning streak at the US Open. Sabalenka had not lost at Flushing Meadows since her defeat to Coco Gauff in the 2023 final.The win earned Rybakina $5.5 million, the biggest prize money in Grand Slam history. She also moved level with Sabalenka and French Open champion Mirra Andreeva for the most titles on the WTA Tour this season, with three each.Sabalenka’s bid to win a third straight US Open title ended in the final, and her frustration was visible both during and after the match.The first signs came in the opening set when Sabalenka committed a costly double fault to surrender the first break of the match. In an immediate, fiery reaction to losing the game, she hit a tennis ball into the crowd. According to broadcasters, as quoted by Athlon Sports, the ball struck a courtside camera near the floor.After the match, Sabalenka smashed her rackets on the court after missing the chance to become only the third woman in the Open Era to win the US Open title three years in a row.Her disappointment continued after the trophy ceremony as well. While sitting with her team, she was approached by a video creator, but appeared to gesture for the person to leave as she tried to process the defeat."It's really tough to control your emotions when you lose in the final of the Grand Slam and when you were trying to go for three-peat," Sabalenka told reporters."I just wanted to let it go, because if I would hold it inside. I wouldn't be able to say a word. I would just go not really nice over there."
Article Summary: Elena rybakina beat aryna sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final of the us open. The win earned the russian $5.5 million, the biggest prize money in grand slam history. It also took her to the no. 1 spot in the wta rankings for the first time.

Article Title: Inspiring story of the day: “Having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you” - How Trinity Rodman rose above Dennis Rodman’s shadow, lived in motels, and built her own soccer legacy
Article Text:
Inspiring story of the day: “Having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you” - How Trinity Rodman rose above Dennis Rodman’s shadow, lived in motels, and built her own soccer legacy

How did Trinity Rodman live in a car despite being Dennis Rodman’s daughter

Call Her Daddy

What did Trinity Rodman say about her relationship with Dennis Rodman

Why does Trinity Rodman call Michelle Moyer her role model?

How did Trinity Rodman turn a difficult childhood into a soccer career

Why is Trinity Rodman’s story inspiring beyond soccer

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Trinity Rodman has built a soccer career that now stands on its own. The Washington Spirit star is a 2024 Olympic gold medalist, a 2021 NWSL champion and, as of January 2026, the highest-paid player in NWSL history. But her childhood looked very different from what many people expected from the daughter of NBA legend Dennis Rodman . Trinity and her brother DJ once lived with their mother, Michelle Moyer, in a Ford Expedition and cheap motels in Newport Beach. Through those difficult years, Michelle kept life feeling normal for her children. That bond helped shape Trinity into the player she is today.Having a famous father did not mean Trinity Rodman grew up with an easy life. After Dennis Rodman and Michelle Moyer separated, Trinity, her brother DJ and their mother faced serious money problems. For a period, they moved between a Ford Expedition and motels when Michelle could afford a room.The situation was especially strange because they were living in Newport Beach, where Trinity went to a wealthy school. She has spoken about seeing classmates arrive in expensive cars while her own family was trying to work out where they would stay.On, Trinity explained just how unusual those years were:“We had a Ford Expedition and we lived in that for a little bit. Mind you, in Newport Beach… So imagine living in a car going to a rich school when everybody else is in Rolls-Royces and Range Rovers. But my mom tried to make every situation seem smoother than it actually was. For me and DJ, it was never embarrassing because we had each other and we had our mom.”For Trinity and DJ, however, those memories were not only painful. Their mother tried hard to make sure they still had happy childhood moments. At motels, they could eat breakfast, use the pool and spend time together before school. That helped the children see their family life differently from how an outsider might have seen it.Trinity’s relationship with Dennis Rodman has remained one of the most talked-about parts of her story, but it has also been one of the most painful. She has said that her father was often absent while she was growing up and that there were long periods when they had little contact.That distance became impossible to ignore as Trinity began making a name for herself in soccer. Instead of being known only as an athlete, she was repeatedly asked about being Dennis Rodman’s daughter.She later spoke openly about how difficult that connection could feel:“He’s a person. He’s not a dad. Maybe by blood, but nothing else… Hearing his voice is painful because it’s missing him mixed with the fact that he’s an alcoholic. I answer the phone now for my conscience, but it took me a long time to realize that having a dad with a big name doesn’t do the work for you. I had to build everything myself.”Dennis has also publicly admitted that he was not the father he wanted to be. At his Basketball Hall of Fame induction, he said he wished he had been a better father.For Trinity, though, her own career could not depend on her father’s reputation. Her speed, finishing, attacking ability and work on the field became the things that made people remember her.If Dennis Rodman gave Trinity a famous last name, Michelle Moyer gave her the support that helped her grow into a professional athlete. Michelle raised Trinity and DJ largely as a single mother and remained closely involved in Trinity’s soccer journey.The Guardian reported in 2021 that Trinity saw her mother as her main support system. That feeling has remained central to how she talks about her childhood and her success.Trinity put it simply:“My mom wasn’t in the NBA, but she’s my role model. She is my world, my rock, and my right hand. She’s the strongest person I know. People always say, ‘Oh, you get your athleticism from your dad,’ but my work ethic, my heart, my grit, and the woman I am today-that’s 100% my mom.”That is an important part of Trinity’s story because her biggest influence was not another famous athlete. It was the person who was there when money was tight, when the family had nowhere stable to stay and when Trinity was still only a young girl trying to understand her world.Trinity’s soccer career moved quickly once she reached the professional level. She entered the NWSL with the Washington Spirit in 2021 and became the youngest player ever selected in the league’s draft at the time. She went on to win the NWSL Rookie of the Year award and helped the Spirit win the league championship that same year.Her rise continued with the U.S. women’s national team. She became an important attacking player for the USWNT and was part of the squad that won Olympic gold at the 2024 Paris Games.The success also changed the way her name was viewed. Instead of being introduced mainly as Dennis Rodman’s daughter, Trinity became a major soccer star in her own right.In January 2026, she reached another major point in her career when she re-signed with the Washington Spirit on a deal worth more than $2 million per year. The agreement made her the highest-paid player in NWSL history.That achievement says a lot about how far she has come. The girl who once went to school after sleeping in a car is now one of the biggest names in American women’s soccer.Trinity Rodman’s story is not simply about becoming famous despite having a difficult childhood. It is about how she chose to define herself.She could have spent her career being introduced through her father’s name. Instead, she has built an identity around her own performances and the people who stood beside her. Her mother remained a constant presence, while soccer gave Trinity a place where her effort could speak for itself.Her journey also explains why the success means more than trophies and contracts. The Olympic gold medal, NWSL championship and record-breaking deal are major achievements, but they came after years of work that had little to do with her father’s fame.Trinity has been clear about that point herself: a famous parent can give someone a name, but it cannot do the training, handle the pressure or play the game for them.For Trinity Rodman, the most important part of her legacy may be that she did not allow her father’s story to become her own. She took the difficult parts of her childhood, held on to the support her mother gave her and built a career that now belongs completely to her.
Article Summary: Trinity rodman has built a soccer career that now stands on its own. The washington spirit star is a 2024 olympic gold medalist, a 2021 nwsl champion and the highest-paid player in nwsl history. But her childhood looked very different from what many people expected from the daughter of nba legend dennis rodman.

Article Title: ‘We need to sit down and reflect on our mistakes’: Babar Azam calls for changes after Pakistan’s 0-3 England sweep
Article Text:
Pakistan's Babar Azam, center, with teammates following his side's defeat to England in Birmingham. (AP Photo)

‘Unfortunately, we have a couple of changes after losing two matches’

Babar backs Razaullah after breakthrough Test

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Pakistan captain Babar Azam has called for an honest assessment of the team's mistakes and selection strategy after England completed a 3-0 Test series sweep with an eight-wicket victory at Edgbaston on Saturday.Babar admitted Pakistan now need to reassess their personnel and decide on their best playing XI after a difficult tour in which the visitors struggled to adapt to English conditions. He said the team management, selectors and captain would need to sit together and determine the way forward.“I think we need to sit down and reflect on our mistakes, decide what type of playing eleven, and decide our players. I think they are sitting, and the manager is coming, the selector is coming, and I sit back and then decide our best eleven,” Babar said after the defeat.The series ended with Pakistan's batting showing signs of improvement in Birmingham. After being bowled out for under 200 in both innings of the opening two Tests, they posted 449 in their second innings at Edgbaston to set England a target of 130.Debutant Razaullah provided the biggest spark for Pakistan, making an immediate impact with both bat and ball. He took four wickets in England's first innings before smashing 81 off 63 balls, including nine sixes.Shan Masood scored 95, Babar contributed 76 and opener Azam Awais made 59 as Pakistan finally offered substantial resistance with the bat.Mohammad Abbas then gave the visitors a glimmer of hope by removing two England batters in the opening over of England's chase. Babar admitted Pakistan briefly believed they could force an unlikely result before Joe Root and Jordan Cox took control.“Yes. We took two wickets in the first over. So we believe high, always high. But I think Root and both batsmen playing are very good,” he said.Root finished unbeaten on 62 and Cox scored 59, with their unbroken 128-run partnership taking England to victory.Reflecting on Pakistan's selection throughout the series, Babar described the changes made after the first two defeats as unfortunate, while also pointing to the difficulty of batting in the conditions.“Before we come here, we think about different things, and then we decide our team. And then unfortunately, we have a couple of changes after losing two matches because when we are coming to England, it is very difficult for the batsmen, and the first two pitches are very difficult,” he said.While Pakistan leave England with plenty to reconsider, Razaullah's performance offered a major positive. Despite his limited first-class experience, the youngster made an immediate impression on Test debut.“We enjoyed it. I think everyone is enjoying his innings and bowling, and he is a very good talent and raw. I think he’s good for us. The way he played this match and he’s giving confidence,” Babar said.The captain also stressed the importance of giving young players opportunities while adapting the team's approach according to conditions.“When you’re coming to different series, you try to do your best, and you decide what type of cricket to play in different conditions. I think these conditions are difficult, but I think we try to get all the new boys to utilise their talent in here,” he said.The 3-0 defeat leaves Pakistan at the bottom of the World Test Championship standings. Their points percentage has dropped from 16.67 to 14.81, with only two wins and eight points deducted for slow over-rates.
Article Summary: England completed a 3-0 test series sweep with an eight-wicket victory at edgbaston on saturday. Pakistan captain babar azam has called for an honest assessment of the team's mistakes and selection strategy. He said the team management, selectors and captain would need to sit together and determine the way forward.

England completed a 3-0 clean sweep of Pakistan with an eight-wicket win in the third Test at Edgbaston, finishing a one-sided series in style. The hosts won the three matches by an innings and 103 runs, 194 runs, and eight wickets.Pakistan’s tour ended on a disappointing note despite major changes before the final Test. The team made several changes to the playing squad and coaching staff ahead of the Edgbaston match, but the move did not change the outcome.Pakistan were bowled out for 133 in the first innings, the fifth time in the series they failed to cross the 200-run mark. They responded with a much better effort in the second innings, scoring 449 after fifties from Azan Awais, Shan Masood, Babar Azam and debutant Razaullah, whose lower-order batting stood out.England had already taken control of the match by building a 320-run first-innings lead, with five batters scoring half-centuries.Chasing 130 for victory, England lost openers Ben Duckett and Emilio Gay in the first over to Mohammad Abbas. Joe Root and Jordan Cox then scored unbeaten fifties to guide England home.England’s victory did not change their position in the World Test Championship standings, as they remained sixth.However, their points percentage improved to 38.54.Pakistan stayed at the bottom of the nine-team table, with their points percentage dropping further to 14.81.India remain fifth in the WTC standings with a points percentage of 51.52 after five wins, four losses and two draws in 11 matches in the current cycle.India’s next assignment in the WTC will be a two-Test series in New Zealand, starting on November 19 in Wellington.
Article Summary: England completed a 3-0 clean sweep of pakistan with an eight-wicket win in the third test at edgbaston. Article Title: Chaminda Vaas to join Delhi Capitals as bowling coach
Article Text:

Article Title: ‘I’d be open to it’: Mike Hesson eyes Pakistan Test role as Shaheen Afridi makes red-ball return
Article Text:
Pakistan's head coach Mike Hesson, center, raises a hand while speaking to the team. (AP Photo)

‘When you’re free, you should play domestic cricket’

Mike Hesson has opened the door to a permanent role as Pakistan’s Test coach after stepping in for the third Test in the team’s 0-3 series whitewash against England, while Shaheen Shah Afridi has made his own intentions clear by declaring that red-ball cricket remains his “first priority”.Hesson, who was handed interim charge of Pakistan’s Test side after the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) removed Sarfaraz Ahmed following the defeat at Lord’s, admitted he would be interested in continuing with the red-ball setup.“I’d be open to it, for sure,” Hesson said at the post-match press conference.The New Zealander had initially made it clear that his Test coaching assignment was temporary. But after Pakistan’s eight-wicket defeat at Edgbaston completed England’s 3-0 series sweep, Hesson suggested he sees enough potential in the squad to consider taking on the responsibility permanently.Hesson said Pakistan have enough ability within their Test system to make progress, although he acknowledged that rebuilding the side would require time and direction.“I love Test cricket, and there’s enough talent around the system in Pakistan that if we provide some good direction, we can make some strides going forward. It’s not going to happen in a game or two, but there’s some skill there I’d certainly be considering looking after,” he said.However, Hesson stressed that any decision on his future would involve the PCB and selectors. His immediate focus remains Pakistan’s white-ball commitments, particularly the Asian Games “I haven’t even contemplated [a job offer] at this stage. I’ve got the Asian Games coming a week after I get back. That’s my main focus in terms of the white ball. By the time that arrives, I’m sure we’ll have some discussions about the Test team going forward. That’s a discussion I’ll have with the selectors,” he said.Pakistan's Test campaign ended on a disappointing note despite a spirited second-innings fightback.As Pakistan look to rebuild their Test side, Afridi’s return to first-class cricket could provide a significant boost. The left-arm pacer featured in the President’s Trophy on Saturday, making his first competitive domestic red-ball appearance since 2019.“Red-ball cricket is always my first priority,” Afridi said, as per the ICC website.“I’ve always loved it. I didn’t get enough time to play because of international cricket, but I haven’t been playing much cricket for the last couple of months. So it’s an opportunity to play red-ball cricket,” he added.Afridi, who has 126 wickets in 34 Tests, was left out of Pakistan’s squads for the West Indies and England tours. He said returning to longer-format cricket would help sharpen his rhythm and confidence.“I learned a lot from my elder brother Riaz Afridi, because he’s played a lot of first-class cricket,” he said. “In the longer format, the longer you spend time on the ground (the better it is) for your confidence, and for your line and length to get fine-tuned.”Afridi also acknowledged the difficulty of switching between formats after spending much of his career on an intense international schedule.“I’ve not played red-ball cricket for the last few months. Before that, I’d been playing red-ball cricket continuously,” he said.“If you play international cricket, then coming back to domestic cricket can be challenging. Because you’ve been playing international cricket constantly in all three formats, it keeps you busy. When you’re free, you should play domestic cricket.”The pacer said he would not alter his approach with the ball in first-class cricket.“I’ll try to bowl the same way in first-class cricket as I’ve bowled in Test cricket,” Afridi said.

Shaheen shah afridi has made his own intentions clear by declaring that red-ball cricket remains his “first priority” the pacer said he would not alter his approach with the ball in first-class cricket.

Article Title: Could Kim Kardashian become the first passenger in Lewis Hamilton’s untouched Ferrari F40?

Kim Kardashian and Lewis Hamilton (Image via Getty Images)

Lewis Hamilton’s Ferrari F40 has an extraordinary history

Could Kim Kardashian be Lewis Hamilton’s first Ferrari F40 passenger?

Lewis Hamilton’s dream Ferrari F40 has arrived with a story almost as striking as the car itself. The Formula 1 superstar found an exceptionally low-mileage example that had spent years untouched, with its passenger door never opened. Now, that tiny detail has sparked an intriguing question among fans: could Kim Kardashian become the first person to sit beside Hamilton in the legendary Ferrari?Hamilton did not simply want another rare Ferrari. He wanted one that felt untouched and carried a story of its own. That search eventually led him to an F40 that had travelled only 69 kilometres before being parked and covered.The detail makes the purchase particularly special. Ferrari’s F40 is already one of the most celebrated cars ever produced by the Italian marque. Built as a raw, lightweight performance machine, it was designed with speed and driving involvement at its heart. For a collector like Hamilton, finding an example that has barely been driven adds another layer of appeal.Hamilton explained that authenticity mattered more to him than simply owning a low-mileage F40.“I've been looking for one for a while and I wanted one with low mileage. I wanted one with a story, and lots have come up in auction over the past couple of years, some with low mileage, but just not particularly special, or maybe the paint's been redone or something like that."His newly acquired Ferrari appears to tick those boxes. According to the details shared by Hamilton, the previous owner drove it from Maranello to his home and then left it untouched. The car reportedly remained covered after that short journey.That means Hamilton has not only acquired a highly desirable supercar. He has also bought a remarkably preserved piece of Ferrari history.The biggest curiosity surrounding Hamilton’s new Ferrari is not about its engine or performance. It is the untouched passenger seat.Hamilton revealed that the passenger door had never been opened. That means the first person to climb into that side of the car could become part of its unusual story. Fans have naturally connected that detail with Kim Kardashian, following the growing public interest in their relationship.Hamilton described exactly how unusual the car was when he found it.“I wanted to find the most authentic one and managed to come across this one that the owner had bought, drove it from Maranello to his home, 69 kilometres, and then parked it and never started it again. The passenger door had never been opened.”There is also another remarkable coincidence. During the restoration process, Ferrari’s team reportedly discovered that the engine carried the number 44, Hamilton’s famous Formula 1 racing number.For a driver who has spent his career surrounded by racing machinery, that detail must have made an already special purchase even more personal.Whether Kardashian will actually become the Ferrari F40’s first passenger remains speculation for now. Hamilton, however, has certainly found a car that combines rarity, history and a few details that seem almost too perfect to be true. And if its passenger door eventually opens for the first time, fans will be watching closely to see who gets the historic seat.

Article Title: Former 7x All-Star showers huge praise for $49.37 million Charlotte Hornets forward ahead of NBA season opener
Article Text:
Brandon Miller. Image via: Rich Storry/Getty Images

Tracy McGrady showers praise on Brandon Miller

Hornets reshape the roster to clear Miller's path

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Miller's rookie deal and what comes next

Brandon Miller is walking into a defining year, and Tracy McGrady thinks he already has the tools to become Charlotte's next star. The seven-time All-Star weighed in on Miller's trajectory as the Hornets forward prepares for his fourth NBA season, and the praise carries real weight given McGrady's own history as a franchise scorer.With LaMelo Ball now in Minnesota and Miles Bridges shipped to Phoenix, Charlotte has cleared a path for Miller to take charge. McGrady believes this is the right moment for the young wing to make his leap.Speaking on Cousins with Vince Carter, McGrady pointed to Miller as the player who can carry the Hornets into their next chapter. The 23-year-old wing is taking on a much bigger role now that Ball has moved on, and McGrady expects it to show up in the numbers. He said Miller "should be a guy that averages 25-26 points, taking that next step."It's a bold number to hang on a young player, but McGrady clearly sees enough in Miller's game to back it up. He added that this season should reveal whether Miller becomes the franchise cornerstone Charlotte needs him to be.Last season, Miller played 65 games and averaged 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.3 assists a game, shooting 43.5 percent from the field and 38.3 percent from three.It was actually a slight dip from his second-year averages of 21 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.6 assists on 40.3 percent shooting and 35.5 percent from deep. Numbers aside, what stands out is the trust the front office has placed in him.Charlotte went through a serious shake-up this offseason. Ball was sent to the Timberwolves and Bridges was dealt to the Suns, leaving Miller and second-year wing Kon Knueppel as the clear building blocks going forward.Knueppel is coming off a strong rookie year of his own, averaging 18.5 points, 5.3 rebounds and 3.4 assists while shooting 47.5 percent overall and 42.5 percent from three. The 6-foot-7 forward and Knueppel give Charlotte a modern, versatile pairing to build around, but McGrady's comments suggest Miller is the one with the higher ceiling. How Charlotte performs this season will say a lot about whether that faith was earned.The $49 million star is entering the final year of his four-year rookie contract, one that carries a 2026-27 cap hit of $15,104,626. He is now eligible for a rookie-scale extension, and Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson has confirmed the two sides have already started talking.Insiders project a new deal could land somewhere around $191 million to $200 million over five years if it gets done before the deadline. If no agreement is reached, Miller would hit restricted free agency in the summer of 2027. For now, the bigger story is what he does on the floor, and McGrady has made it clear he expects big things.The Charlotte Hornets will begin their 2026-27 NBA regular-season campaign on the road against the Brooklyn Nets on Wednesday, October 21, 2026.
Article Summary: Tracy mcgrady believes brandon miller can be charlotte's next star. Mcgrady says miller should average 25-26 points a game this season. The 23-year-old wing is taking on a much bigger role now that lamelo ball has moved on. Miller and kon knueppel are the clear building blocks going forward.

Article Title: Ben Shelton reaches US Open final, one win away from ending America’s 22-year wait
Article Text:
Ben Shelton, of the United States (AP Photo)

Shelton survives another demanding stretch

Tiafoe's semifinal jinx continues

Shelton's serve changes the contest

Star-studded crowd watches American showdown

Zverev stands between Shelton and history

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Ben Shelton is one victory away from ending the United States' long wait for a men's Grand Slam champion after winning an all-American US Open semifinal against Frances Tiafoe on Friday.The No. 8 seed recovered from losing the opening set to beat Tiafoe 4-6, 6-3, 6-3, 7-5 and book his place in his first major final.Shelton will face top seed Alexander Zverev in Sunday's championship match, with the German having earlier defeated Karen Khachanov 6-3, 7-6 (7), 7-6 (6).A victory over French Open champion Zverev would give the United States its first men's Grand Slam champion since Andy Roddick won the US Open in 2003."I'm going for it here, and I'm going to leave it all on the court," Shelton said. "I hope you guys come and back me. Let's do it for the USA."Zverev, meanwhile, is looking to add a second major title this year after finally breaking his Grand Slam drought at the French Open."Hopefully I can not make the American dream come true on Sunday," Zverev said.Shelton's run to the final has come despite an exhausting schedule.The 23-year-old from Georgia defeated defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a quarterfinal that finished at 3:33 a.m.on Wednesday, the latest ending to a match in US Open history.Yet Shelton showed no signs of running out of energy against Tiafoe.The two Americans had both needed match tiebreakers in their respective quarterfinals, but Shelton produced the stronger finish when it mattered most."This is where we want to be: at the tail end of this tournament," Shelton said. "This is both of our favorite tournament in the world, our favorite court in the world and to be able to light it up in front of (this crowd) is the best feeling that there is."Shelton was less than a year old when Roddick won his US Open title. Now, more than two decades later, he has a chance to become the American who finally brings the men's Grand Slam trophy back home.Tiafoe's latest US Open campaign ended with another semifinal defeat.The American is now 0-3 in US Open semifinals, with each of his last two losses coming against compatriots. Taylor Fritz defeated him in 2024 before going on to lose the final to Jannik Sinner.Tiafoe had also produced one of the tournament's most dramatic comebacks in the quarterfinals, recovering from two sets down before overcoming fellow American Alex Michelsen after erasing a 3-0 deficit in the deciding set.He began the semifinal as the cleaner player. After a ceremony commemorating the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks, which featured a giant American flag unfurled across the court, Tiafoe made only three unforced errors in the opening set compared with 14 from Shelton.Shelton's double fault at 4-4 handed Tiafoe the break, and the latter closed out the opening set.But the momentum shifted quickly.Shelton responded by increasing the power on his serve and eventually finished the match with 20 aces.At 3-3 in the second set, serving with new balls, he opened with a 125 mph delivery. Tiafoe managed to get his racket to the ball almost in self-defense but was knocked backwards onto the court.Shelton then followed with serves measured at 144, 139 and 140 mph. The final two produced aces and helped him establish control of the set.The third set featured another major test.Tiafoe fought desperately to hold serve in the final game, but the battle lasted 15 minutes and 20 points before he sent a forehand into the net. Shelton took the set and moved within one of reaching the final.The eighth seed then completed the job in the fourth, closing out the match 7-5.The semifinal attracted a high-profile crowd, with sports and entertainment stars turning up for the all-American contest.Serena Williams, Jalen Brunson and US soccer player Trinity Rodman, Shelton's girlfriend, were among those in attendance, alongside actors Salma Hayek, Ben Stiller and Rami Malek.The atmosphere reflected the significance of the occasion, with both Shelton and Tiafoe attempting to become the latest American man to reach a Grand Slam final.Only Shelton managed to take the next step.Standing in Shelton's way is a player who knows exactly what it means to wait for a first major.Zverev had long been regarded as the best men's player without a Grand Slam title before finally winning the French Open this year. He then reached the Wimbledon final, where he lost to Jannik Sinner.The German has gone 24-2 in Grand Slam matches this season and is now back in another major final."Sometimes just things go your way and I feel like I’ve had a lot of struggles at the major level, I was so close so many times, and maybe this year God has said that this is going to be your year and just enjoy the time on the court," Zverev said.Sunday's final will also give Zverev another chance to erase one of the most painful memories of his career.In the 2020 US Open final, he won the first two sets against Dominic Thiem but eventually lost in a fifth-set tiebreak. Thiem became the first man since 1949 to win the US Open after dropping the opening two sets.Zverev has been far more composed after taking early leads this year. He has now won 13 consecutive sets after becoming the first No. 1-seeded man to play five-set matches in each of the first two rounds of a major.Now, Shelton stands between him and another Grand Slam trophy, while the American has the chance to do something no US men's player has managed since Roddick in 2003.
Article Summary: Ben shelton beats frances tiafoe in straight sets to reach us open final. Shelton will face top seed alexander zverev in sunday's championship match. Victory would give the united states its first men's grand slam champion since 2003. Shelton beats tiafoe 7-5, 7-6 (7-4), 6-4 in the us open semifinals.

Bengaluru: Two-time champions Triveni Continental Kings, who featured in the finals of all the three previous editions of the Global Chess League (GCL), crashed out of the fourth edition on Friday. They remained at the bottom of the standings in the six-team league.Led by Alireza Firouzja, the youngest player to reach Elo rating of 2800 in 2021, the Kings were expected to put up another spirited fight but they lost their way early in the Garden City. On Friday, they took down the V Anand-led PBG Alaskan Knights 13-7 which ensured the Knights also went out of the reckoning.The win, powered by the women - Zhu Jiner and Alexandra Kosteniuk - together with Pranav Venkatesh on the prodigy board, was only their third in nine matches which sealed their fate. Last season, the Kings won eight out of their 10 matches.CheQ Mumbai Masters (12 match-points), with Maxime Vachier-Lagrave on the icon board, are also out of the final reckoning. Ganges Grandmasters, Alpine AL Pipers (18 each) and Fyres American Gambits (15) are the only three teams remaining in contention. The top-two teams make it to the Sunday's two-set final after Saturday's last day of the league phase.World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen began to shift gears as the tournament neared the business end.He took down world championship challenger Javokhir Sindarov with white pieces that helped Alpine Pipers edge Fyers American Gambits 9-7. Carlsen gave away his Player of the Match award to teammate Vidit Gujrathi after the latter defeated the Norwegian's former second Daniil Dubov of Russia.Pipers are now level with Grandmasters but dropped to second with 82 game-points compared to Ganges' 88. Ganges stormed to the top of the table after thrashing Mumba Masters 16-1.Kings' coach Loek van Wely was at a loss for words. He told TOI, "It's really hard to say (now) what went wrong. We need to evaluate when the dust settles, we need to analyze. "Against Ganges (Grandmasters), we should have won both matches. Sometimes, the margin is very small. The match can look very good and then in the final two minutes everything will change. The higher the level, the differences are getting smaller."

India's next Test assignment will take them to New Zealand for a two-match series beginning November 19, and former Kiwi fast bowler Trent Boult believes KL Rahul will be one of the Indian batters worth watching closely.The two Tests will form part of India's marathon New Zealand tour, which begins on October 22 and features 12 matches across the three formats. With India needing a strong result to remain in contention for the World Test Championship (WTC) final, the spotlight is expected to fall on several key players, including captain Shubman Gill and pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah .Boult, however, has picked Rahul and his opening partner Yashasvi Jaiswal as the two Indian batters he is particularly looking forward to seeing in action."I'm always a big fan of KL Rahul and his style of batsmanship. Unlike India's previous Test tours of New Zealand, which have often taken place in the February-March window, this series will be played in late October and November.Boult feels the timing could bring colder weather into play, while he is hoping the New Zealand pitches retain some grass and offer assistance to the home attack."It's always an exciting chance when the Indian team comes down to play Test cricket in New Zealand," Boult said."The only thing I can see happening is it's going to be late October. I believe, just coming out of winter. So it's going to be quite cold. Hopefully, there's a bit of greenness in the wickets for some of our bowlers. It's going to be a good series, I'm sure," the star former Kiwi pacer added.Boult also backed the current New Zealand bowling unit to make an impact against India, pointing to the variety available to the team.Kyle Jamieson, Matt Henry, Nathan Smith and Will O'Rourke bring different qualities to the attack, and Boult believes that gives New Zealand enough options to develop its own identity."I think the bowling is very well balanced. Obviously, a bit of swing and a bit of bounce from Kyle Jamieson and Matt Henry with his accuracy."So yeah, I think the way me, Tim (Southee) and Wags (Neil Wagner) did it over the years was a unique way in itself.
